---
title: "Interactive map"
subtitle: "BF-NEE by grid cell, period, ecosystem group and commodity"
page-layout: full
toc: false
---

Choose a period, an ecosystem group and a commodity. The map shows either the
agriculture-constrained natural ecosystem loss or the BF-NEE (loss × attribution
weight of the producing country). Hover over a cell for its value; select a country
to zoom in and see its totals.

```{=html}
<iframe class="map-frame"
        src="https://sh33caqo.shinyapps.io/bf-nee-global-map/"
        title="Interactive BF-NEE map"
        loading="lazy"
        allowfullscreen></iframe>
```

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" collapse="true"}
## About the map data

Cells are aggregated for the web (about 18 km); values are km² per displayed cell.
Totals in the side panel come from the country tables, not from the display raster.
The map data are built on the cluster with `data-raw/02_build_map_data.R` and
uploaded with `shiny/global_map/deploy.R`.
:::
